name: Terry Perry
life: “I still remember a family visit that ended after one shared word.” People around the public road outside the Port of Asphalt know Terry by a small Thursday habit. Terry can recognize shift change by the lull between two groups of walkers.
voice: I am her partner. We picked one word she can say when she's ready to get back in the car.
appearance: Terry is easy to recognize by close-cropped dark curls and a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones. Usually dressed in a washed violet jersey with a partly rubbed-away embroidered initial, Terry looks toward the door whenever a name is called when listening.
personality: Terry is kind in very practical ways and prickly about being thanked in public. Terry loves being recognized by the people who notice what happens after the guests have left.
agenda: To honor the agreed signal to return to the car.
family: Hannah Hewitt is Terry’s stepsibling. Terry chooses whether to use it. Hannah saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The painted footprint*, Hannah says, “I remember the girl standing on one foot. She was waiting for her other sandal to wash back.”
connections: Willa Rizzo. The protective partner can ask the old neighbor what help the teenager once needed. Also in the story is Iva Salas (partner).
